text: The AI model has identified a pattern on the brain MRI that is consistent with a meningioma, a tumour that arises from the meninges and is the most common primary brain tumour [nci-meningioma]. This output represents a classification of the imaging appearance, not a definitive diagnosis, and it does not convey information about tumour grade or growth rate, which cannot be judged from a single study [ncbi-meningioma-statpearls]. Meningiomas are often slow-growing and may be discovered incidentally, although clinical effects depend on location, size, growth and histological grade [ncbi-meningioma-statpearls]. A clinician would typically discuss a detailed neurological examination and a dedicated contrast-enhanced MRI using a brain-tumour protocol, as well as review by a neurosurgical or neurological specialist [nci-meningioma][ncbi-meningioma-statpearls]. If tissue is obtained, histological grading can inform management, and interval imaging is useful to establish growth rate [nci-meningioma][ncbi-meningioma-statpearls]. Ongoing specialist review, serial imaging and reassessment if new symptoms appear are part of standard follow-up considerations [icom-meningioma-consensus][nci-meningioma].
